Twin_Cut_Diagonal.choreography: Right advance with a left-blade cover

Twin_Cut_Return.choreography: Left advance into the return cut

Twin_Cut_Rising.choreography: Narrow staggered step and rising body drive

Twin_Cut_Sweep.choreography: Left lateral step through alternating sweeps

Twin_Heavy_Cleave.choreography: Deep right receiving step under descending blades

Twin_Heavy_Rising.choreography: Left staggered cross-step from a low load

Twin_Heavy_Sweep.choreography: Wide right traverse and counter-rotating return

Twin_Heavy_Slam.choreography: Left receiving step into a compact crouched finish

Twin_Musou_Flow.choreography: Alternating paired-blade cuts with sequential turning steps and a low final receiving stance
